trust_decision.summary: A DataObject class-definition field name (admin/import controlled) is trusted as a safe identifier and emitted verbatim into generated PHP class files and into ALTER TABLE DDL; decided nowhere at the pinned commit (Data::setName stores it as-is, Helper\Dao backtick-wraps it without escaping).

landing_point.why: Advisory names 'DataObject Class-Definition Field Name' and RCE; Data::setName is the obvious setter for a field name and the place to add an identifier check; DDL in the Helper\Dao trait is a second, SQL-flavoured sink in another file.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Once setName validates the name, the DDL in the @internal Helper\Dao trait 'only ever sees valid identifiers', and other DDL inputs (column types, StructuredTable keys, existing DB column names on drop, classificationstore names) belong to neighbouring features, not to 'the field name'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: StructuredTable row/col keys are only lower-cased and become column names containing '#' (and possibly '.'), Date/Datetime/DateRange legitimately set column types like 'bigint(20)', Localizedfields must stay named 'localizedfields' and the empty name must be accepted transiently; an over-broad identifier regex on all DDL column names, or quoting that splits on '.', breaks these.

field name with backtick - DDL identifier breakout
leading digit, space, dash, over-long (>63) names
single-column vs multi-column (array columnType, name__key) index/column names
unique composite index with localized 'language' / fieldcollection 'fieldname' column
ADD COLUMN vs CHANGE COLUMN (existing column name read back from DB)
